what: Two wrong warnings, each with a blaze-engine tests/repro.rs test (both reproduce on blaze 00:59): (1) a_derived_impl_warns_of_no_unreachable_pattern: #[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Debug, Default)] on struct Ctrl<const SLOTS: usize>(u64) warns "unreachable pattern ... no value can reach this" at the derive (blaze-mem swiss.rs, llvm-sys build.rs include!; lints/bodies/patterns.rs or hir-ty-matchck). (2) blazes_own_lint_in_a_workspaces_lints_is_known: [workspace.metadata.blaze.lints] hot_alloc = "warn" with [lints] workspace = true gives warning[E0602] unknown lint: blaze::hot_alloc (requested on the command line with -W blaze::hot_alloc), on every member of blaze s own workspace.
